subject.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles

question: Should literal and SecretRef `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` values outrank stored auth profiles by default when `auth: "api-key"` is not set?
rationale: Current docs, status labeling, and current-main resolver policy preserve profile-first behavior, while this PR intentionally changes credential-source selection for existing configs.

options.title: Keep profile-first default
options.body: Require this PR to preserve the documented stored-profile default and use the existing `auth: "api-key"` opt-in for users who want config keys to win.

options.title: Adopt explicit-key-first default
options.body: Approve the compatibility change only after runtime dispatch, status labels, docs, tests, and upgrade proof all agree on the new credential order.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Land only placeholder/status fixes that match current runtime precedence and leave the default auth-policy change for a maintainer-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep profile-first default
recommendation.body: Require this PR to preserve the documented stored-profile default and use the existing `auth: "api-key"` opt-in for users who want config keys to win.
